صَاهِلَةٌ : see صَهِيلٌ: and see also ثُغَآءٌ, in art. ثغو. ―
-b2- Its pl., صَوَاهِلُ, is also applied (by the poet Aboo-Zubeyd Et-Tá-ee, O, TA) to The sounds of مَسَاحٍ [i. e. iron shovels or spades]. (O, K.) Also (by the poet Temeem Ibn-Abee-Mukbil, O, TA) to The sounds of flies among herbage; (O, K;) app. meaning the humming or buzzing, [sounds] of their flying. (O, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
